toc.title: How do I find a media timeline?
Can I remove media from my media timeline?

runs: The media timeline on your profile displays the photos, videos, and GIFs you’ve uploaded with your posts. You can also visit other people’s profiles to view their media timelines.
If you don't see your photos or videos hosted by third-party services in your media timeline or in your posts, it means we don't currently support displaying media for that particular service.
The basics about media timelines
Media timelines display the most recent photos, videos, and GIFs in your posts, in chronological order.
Videos and GIFs autoplay while you scroll through the timeline. Read about adjusting your

Can I remove media from my media timeline?
Yes, you can remove media from your media timeline by deleting the post that contains the photo, video, or GIF.

Please note that if you delete a post containing a photo or video hosted by a third-party service, it will also be removed from your media timeline. If you'd like the photo or video to be removed from the third-party service, you'll need to sign in and delete it there as well.
If you copy and paste the URL of someone else's photo into your post (a
), that person's photo will then appear in your media timeline. The photo will not appear in your media timeline if you use the official repost button.
Why are some photos black?
Some photos will temporarily appear black if our content partner's servers are overloaded.
